title: Fix FIPS 140 checksum validation failure
description:
[SRU] Backport FIPS 140 checksum fix to Noble

This fix excludes the bundled FIPS 140 snapshot ZIPs from dh_strip_nondeterminism to preserve the certified upstream checksums. This aligns the golang-1.24 package in Noble with the fix already merged for golang-1.27.

Original approved MP for sponsor context: https://code.launchpad.net/~sumit-tiwari/ubuntu/+source/golang-1.27/+git/golang-1.27/+merge/514448

PPA Build: https://launchpad.net/~sumit-tiwari/+archive/ubuntu/fips-fix/+packages?field.name_filter=golang-1.24&field.status_filter=published&field.series_filter=jammy
commit_message:
Fix FIPS 140 checksum validation failure

LP: #2174696
diff:
diff --git a/debian/changelog b/debian/changelog
index 73b717b..697daa8 100644
--- a/debian/changelog
+++ b/debian/changelog
@@ -1,3 +1,10 @@
+golang-1.24 (1.24.13-2~24.04.2) noble; urgency=medium
+
+  * d/rules: Exclude native fips140 module zips from dh_strip_nondeterminism
+    to preserve upstream checksums and fix Go 1.24 validation (LP: #2174696).
+
+ -- Sumit Tiwari <sumit.tiwari@canonical.com>  Wed, 18 Nov 2026 16:30:08 +0530
+
 golang-1.24 (1.24.13-2~24.04.1) noble; urgency=medium
 
   * Backport to Noble (LP: #2164608)
diff --git a/debian/rules b/debian/rules
index 52fb466..b090243 100755
--- a/debian/rules
+++ b/debian/rules
@@ -92,7 +92,8 @@ override_dh_strip:
 override_dh_dwz:
 
 override_dh_strip_nondeterminism:
-	dh_strip_nondeterminism -Xtestdata
+	dh_strip_nondeterminism -Xtestdata \
+	--exclude=usr/share/go-$(GOVER)/lib/fips140
 
 override_dh_shlibdeps:
 	dh_shlibdeps -Xtestdata -Xtest
